title: Different TCM Asthma Patterns
description: This project focuses on the molecular differences between two core Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndrome patterns of bronchial asthma: lung qi deficiency and phlegm-damp obstructing lung. We integrate transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics and intestinal microbiota data to screen differential biomarkers, clarify the unique molecular regulatory mechanisms of each TCM asthma pattern, and provide objective biological evidence for the modernization and objectification of TCM syndrome differentiation in asthma treatment.
